content:
Sam: Quick sync — seeing cost spikes from fanout; late enrichment replays are duplicating billing attribution for the same trace, especially for low-traffic tenants. anyone noticing?
Priya: yup saw a 2x token count yesterday for a tenant after a retry storm. looks like fanout + late-enrich = duplicates. :grimacing: 
Jules: are these full replays (same envelope id) or new envelopes created by the enrichment step?
Sam: same envelope id usually, but we end up with multiple enrichment results hitting downstream; billing lookup runs per result and counts tokens each time.
Marta: hmm, that sounds like we never coalesce enriched results before the billing aggregation. we should dedupe by envelope id earlier.
Priya: right. current path: ingress -> enqueue -> fanout to enrichers -> enrichers write back -> downstream ingest does billing lookup per enriched envelope. no coalescing.
Sam: possible quick config change: introduce a debounce window at the fanout output so we coalesce multiple enrichment results within X ms.
Jules: can you sketch config?
Sam: something like:
```
fanout.coalesce: true
fanout.debounce_ms: 150
fanout.coalesce_key: envelope_id
```
Priya: 150ms seems reasonable as a starting point. risk: increases tail latency for when enrichments are legitimately staggered.
Marta: alternative: mark enrichers with a sequence number and have downstream idempotent check: accept only highest seq per envelope in a sliding window. less latency cost but more complexity.
Jules: sequence numbers require changing the enrich contract and potentially backfilling. also some enrichers are external and can’t easily guarantee monotonic seq.
Priya: we could do a hybrid: short debounce (100-200ms) + per-envelope dedupe in billing stage keyed by (envelope_id, enrichment_hash). if we see same enrichment_hash twice, ignore.
Sam: enrichment_hash would have to be deterministic across enrichers. should be OK for our current set (geo + pii flags + tag set), but we should be explicit in the contract.
Marta: watch out for memory blowup if we keep dedupe cache per envelope unbounded. need TTL and low-memory eviction policy.
Jules: propose:
- debounce window of 200ms at fanout aggregator
- downstream dedupe cache with TTL=30s and max entries per tenant=5000
- metrics for "dedupe_hits" and "debounce_latency_ms"
Priya: sounds pragmatic. also add a sampling rule: if tenant is high-volume, degrade debounce to 50ms or disable to avoid adding latency to hot paths.
Sam: good call. per-tenant policy: debounce_ms = min(global, tenant_override) and we can set disable for enterprise tenants on Dedicated where SLAs matter.
Marta: how do we handle billing attribution if an enriched result arrives after we've already emitted billing for the earlier one? we need a single source of truth.
Jules: maybe centralize billing attribution to the envelope root service (pre-enrich) and have enrichers only annotate. then only the root service increments billing. but that loses token-level accuracy for enrichers that add tokens.
Priya: true — some enrichers add tokens (e.g., text normalization -> increases token count). centralizing will undercount unless we fetch delta from enricher. that reintroduces a call.
Sam: alternate: when an enricher adds tokens, it returns delta_tokens in the enrichment payload. downstream billing stage aggregates max(delta_tokens) across duplicates instead of sum. that prevents double-count.
Marta: aggregating max sounds safe if deltas are idempotent and non-negative. need to audit all enrichers to ensure they report delta correctly.
Jules: we should also add an explicit "finalized" flag for enrichments to indicate no further updates will arrive; when seen, billing can be finalized immediately.
Priya: action list then:
- add fanout debounce config (default 200ms) with per-tenant override (Sam) :white_check_mark:
- implement downstream dedupe cache (Marta) :in_progress:
- update enrichment contract to include enrichment_hash and delta_tokens and optional finalized flag (Jules) :todo:
- emit metrics: dedupe_hits, dedupe_misses, debounce_p99, billing_double_count_rate (All) :todo:
Marta: I'll prototype dedupe cache with LRU+TTL and a prom export for hits/misses. will surface memory usage.
Sam: I'll open a short-lived feature flag rollout so we can turn on debounce for a subset of tenants and measure cost impact.
Jules: I'll draft a tiny RFC for the enrichment contract changes (hash, delta, finalized) and list the enrichers that need updating.
Priya: we should also add an alert on sudden jump in "billing_double_count_rate" > 1.5x baseline.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: feature flag "fanout-debounce" created for eng-platform, default=off.
Sam: timeline: aim for small rollout next week, full rollout after 2 weeks of metrics validation.
Marta: noted. will spike memory perf this afternoon and share numbers.
Priya: ok — thanks. if we can get a 30-50% reduction in duplicated token billing for affected tenants that'd be a big win. :money_with_wings: 
Sam: great. will follow up with the flag PR and a short demo of the coalescing behavior."
